summary:
Implementation plan for overhauling the TravelBuddy trip planning system. Covers three phases:
1. Trip Planning on Map — unified TripPlan model, save/load routes with waypoints from the map, round trip toggle
2. Trip Sharing — share plans in-app via codes and via WhatsApp deep links
3. Live Trip Mode — real-time location sharing with team, activity-tagged stops (fuel, food, hotel, viewpoint etc.) saved to the trip plan

Includes Firestore schema, file-by-file changes, new files, and verification plan.
